integrity: All finite claims were independently reconstructed from the embedded facet list and published permutation generators by an exhaustive standalone verifier. The earliest-public-date field uses the verified 1880-12-01 publication date of Dyck's classical source; the exact labeled simplicial presentation and modern primary MSC are taken from the 2005 Köhler-Lutz source.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the exact twelve-vertex labeled triangulation and the edge-support metric on simplicial one-cocycles over F2. It is not a metric-geometric systole, does not classify other triangulations of the genus-three surface, and does not address other coefficient fields. Historical geometric-realization literature was compared at bibliographic/abstract level where full text was unavailable, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed duplicate finite computation.
title: Complete mod-two one-cosystolic spectrum of Dyck's regular genus-three map
